Commentary.Commentary: That’s it then from this game then! We have our two finalists, they are Zimbabwe and Netherlands. The two will face each other on the 17th of this month. Till then, goodbye and take care.
Tony Ura is the Man of the Match.

The Zimbabwe bowling was quite decent except to Ura. They really stuck to their plans and the bowlers were chopped and changed quite well. Overall though, it was a complete show from the home side. First a combined effort helped them put up a big total on the board and then their bowling came to the fore to storm into the finals.

Credit though goes to Ura who played a blinder. PNG seemed down and out when they were 34 for 3. Ura and Amini then revived their hopes. Amini fell but Ura continued to make PNG believe. Once he fell though, it was all over as it was too much to ask for from the lower order

It is Zimbabwe who have entered the finals and also confirmed their place in the upcoming T20I World Cup! Credit though to PNG, they batted with the right approach and for sometime were in the chase too.

A single to end. That's it and Zimbabwe win by 27 runs. This is full and on middle, Simon Atai lofts it towards long on for a single. PNG would be dissappointed as no one except Ura could get going. In the end, Zimbabwe proved to be too strong for them.
On a length and on off, Kabua Morea guides it through covers for one.
Full-toss on middle, Simon Atai scoops it to fine leg for a single.
Short again on middle, Simon Atai goes for the pull but could not connect.
Big appeal but turned down. This is short and on middle, Simon Atai goes for the reverse-scoop but gets beaten. Zimbabwe appeals for the catch but the finger stays down.

OUT! BOWLED! This pretty much sums up the day for PNG. Richard Ngarava bowls it in the blockhole, on middle, swinging in. Hila George Vare is beaten for pace here, and the ball goes through him and knocks the stumps over.
Shortish and outside off, Hila George Vare guides it past point for one.
Full and way outside off, wided.
Good-length delivery, outsdie off, Kabua Morea punches it towards deep point for one.
Full and on leg, Kabua Morea flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
SIX! Nice shot! Luke Jongwe goes for the slower bouncer, on middle. Kabua Morea picks up the length early and smokes it over long on for a biggie.
On a length and on off, Hila George Vare pushes it past covers for one.
Full and on middle, Kabua Morea lofts it to long on for a run.
Nicely bowled! This is on a good length, on middle, Hila George Vare goes for the scoop but misses it completely.
This is on a length, outside off, slower again. Kabua Morea cuts it past point for one.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for PNG. This is full and down the leg side, Kabua Morea tickles it past the keepr towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Takes the pace of the ball again, this is on a length and on middle, Hila George Vare pulls it through square leg for a single.
Short and on middle and leg, Hila George Vare pulls it to deep square leg for a brace.

OUT! CAUGHT! Blessing Muzarabani bowls it slower again, wide outside off. Norman Vanua tries to heave it over point but only manages to get the toe end of his bat. The ball goes straight up in the air and Craig Ervine takes an easy running catch at point. Zimbabwe has one foot in the finals now.
Commentary.Howout: c Wellington Masakadza b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, around off, this is dabbed down to backward point for one.
Back of a length, on off, this is played towards cover for one.
WIDE! Full and wide, a bit too wide though.
Excellent running! This is pushed wider, Hila George Vare drives it past the man at point for a couple of runs.
Length ball, around off, this is played through covers for a single.
Full and around off, Vanua looks to slog it away but fails to connect.
Full and straight, this is driven down to long off for a single.
Full and wide, pace on this time. Norman Vanua swings hard but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! The pressure was mounting and Riley Hekure has to depart as well. This is potched up well outside off and the pace is taken off again. Riley Hekure throws his hands at it and ends up getting it off the toe end of the bat. The ball pops up towards extra cover where Craig Ervine takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and wide, but slower in pace again, Riley Hekure swings hard at it but misses again.
Nicely bowled! Short ball, slower in pace and over off stump. Hekure looks to shuffle across and pull it away but misses.
In the air...safe! This is full and wide, Norman Vanua goes after it and gets it off the toe end of the bat over the man at extra cover. Just a single.
Full and straight, Riley Hekure gets an inside edge past the stumps. The ball goes towards fine leg and they get a single.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! A huge, huge moment in the game as Sean Williams gets the big fish. Nicely drifted into leg stump, Tony Ura backs away to drive but gets completely beaten in flight. The ball goes on to hit the top of leg stump and Ura has to walk back after a fighting knock. Papua New Guinea now need 61 runs off 30 balls. Norman Vanua is the new man in.
Leg bye! Slowed up, on middle and leg, Riley Hekure dances down the track, looking to flick it. He misses and the ball goes off the pads towards backward point. Thye get a leg bye.
On middle, pushed away towards wide long on for just a single this time.
Flatter this time, around off, Ura fails to get it away.
Excellent running! Slower and shorter, around off. This is pulled away in front of square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
SIX! Up and over! This is dragged down on off stump, Tony Ura rocks back and pulls it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Good bowling by Richard Ngarava. He bowls it full outside off, shaping away. Riley Hekure goes for the big shot over mid-wicket but could not connect.
EDGY BUT FOUR! This is full and outside off, Riley Hekure tries to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge, the ball goes past his stumps and towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Short again outside off, Riley Hekure punches it through covers for a brace.
Just short! This is full and on middle, Tony Ura tries to heaves it over mid-wicket but mistimes his shot, and the balls falls just short of the deep mid-wicket fielder. They take two runs.
Swing and a miss! Richard Ngarava bowls it full and outside off, Tony Ura tries to go big but misses the ball completely.
Short and on middle, Tony Ura pulls it but straight to mid-wicket.
Beaten again. Full and outside off, Riley Hekure throws his bat but could not connect.
Good bowling. This is full and outside off, Riley Hekure tries to loft it over long off but misses it completely.

Another over the waist delivery. Blessing Muzarabani misses his yorker and bowls a full toss, on middle and leg. Tony Ura manages to pull it to deep square leg for a brace. It is called a no ball for above the waist height.
On a length and on off, Riley Hekure punches it wide of point for one.
BEATEN! This is on a good length, on off. Riley Hekure tries to loft it over covers but misses it completely.

This is well bowled. Tony Ura tries to make room by going to the leg side, Blessing Muzarabani follows him and darts in yorker on the pads, Tony Ura misses his flick and the ball goes to short fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Good length on off, Tony Ura hits it straight to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on leg, Tony Ura knocks it past mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! This is short again on middle and leg, Tony Ura pulls it hard and towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Lands it short on middle, Riley Hekure pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Bowls the yorker well this time, on middle. Riley Hekure digs it out.
Good length but way outside off, wided.

WHAT JUST HAPPENED! This is a full toss outside off, Tony Ura heaves it wide of deep point, Wellington Masakadza takes a brilliant running catch diving to his right. But wait, the umpire has called a No ball for above waist. Tony Ura survives.
Full and on leg, Riley Hekure tries to flick but misses and get hit on the pads and the ball goes to towards short fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Shortish and outside off, Tony Ura pulls it to deep-mid wicket for a run.
Full again on the pads, Riley Hekure flicks it gently through mid-wicket and takes a double.
Slower ball, on a length and on middle, Tony Ura pushes it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, Riley Hekure drills it to long on for a run.

DROPPED! Bangs in a quick short ball on middle and leg, Riley Hekure misses his pull and the ball takes slight edge of his willow, but the keeper could not complete the catch. An oppurtunity missed by Zimbabwe.
FOUR! The boundaries are coming every over. This is short and on middle and leg, Riley Hekure pulls it hard through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the boundary.
A dot to start. Bowls it back of a length outside off, Riley Hekure guides it but straight to point.
Full and on middle, Riley Hekure sweeps it through square leg for a single. Huge over for PNG,16 of it.
Shortish and outside off, Tony Ura pushes it past point for one.
SIX! HUGE! This is short again outside off, Tony Ura makes room and smashes it over the deep point fence for another biggie.
On middle, blocked out.
SIX! BANG! This short on middle and leg, Tony Ura heves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Tony Ura lofts it high towards long on for a brace.

OUT! CAUGHT! Luke Jongwe has the last laugh! A low full toss around off, Charles Amini looks to go over mid off but ends up chipping it off the toe end of the bat. Craig Ervine dives to his left at extra cover and takes a good catch. Amini departs and Papua New Guinea in serious trouble now. Riley Hekure walks in to bat next.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Short again from Luke Jongwe, on leg stump. Charles Amini pulls it behind square on the leg side and picks up a boundary.
Short again, over middle, this is pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and straight, driven firmly towards the bowler who gets a hand on it. The ball hits the wickets at the other end and the batters scamper through for one.
Banged in short and over middle, this is pulled away through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Starts off with a pitched-up delivery on middle, Tony Ura thumps it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On leg stump, Amini wrists it well in front of square on the leg side and hurries back for the second.
Short and outside off, this is tapped in front of cover for an easy single.
This is angled into middle and leg, Amini nudges it towards square leg for one.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Charles Amini gives himself room and drives it through wide mid off for a boundary.
Around off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Flatter delivery, on middle, this is worked off the back foot through mid-wicket by Amini for one.
On middle, pushed away through wide mid on for a single. 138 needed now off 78 balls.
Flatter and around off, played late towards short third man for one.
SIX! Back-to-back! Tossed up again, around off, Ura fetches it and smashes it over the long on fence this time for yet another maximum.
SIX! BANG! Pitched up on off, Tony Ura smoke sit over the long off fence for a huge hit.
A low full toss on off, Tony Ura works it in front of mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs. Good running!
On off, this is swept away behind square on the leg side for a single by Amini.
Quicker and flatter, around off, this is tapped towards cover-point.
On the pads, this is turned through mid-wicket for one more.
Slows it up on a length and on leg stump, this is nudged away towards mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Short and wide, Tony Ura reaches out and slaps it away in front of point for a boundary.
Nicely flighted and on middle, Ura pushes it towards the bowler.
Floated up, on the pads, this is clipped away to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Full and on off, this is thumped away over mid off for a boundary. Ura gets off the mark in style.
Tony Ura is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Wesley Madhevere gets his man! Madhevere holds it back a touch and angles it in from around off. Sese Bau looks to fetch and sweep it away but misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is a huge appeal from the bowler and the dreaded finger is raised. Papua New Guinea in a spot of bother here.
On middle, Bau sweeps again but finds the fielder at square leg.
FOUR! Nicely done. On the pads, swept away hard and low past square leg for a boundary.
This is fuller and sliding down leg, Sese Bau looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter again, on the pads, Amini flicks it off the back foot past square leg for one.
Shorter in length and around off, Sese Bau plays it off the back foot through covers for one.
Difficult chance! Tossed up around off, this is hit hard and straight back towards the bowler who can't react in time and ends up dropping it.

OUT! TIMBER! Sikandar Raza goes quicker and fuller on off stump. Assad Vala looks to take on the slog sweep but ends up playing all over the ball. Vala misses and the ball castles into off stump. Papua New Guinea lose their second and Zimbabwe right on top here. Sese Bau is the new man in.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Two! On middle, this is swept through square leg for two.
FOUR! Slammed away and this is a very good over for the visitors! Short and on off, this is slapped through covers for a boundary.
Another one on the shorter side and angling away from off. Vala looks to pull but misses.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through md-wicket for two.
FOUR BYES! Shorter and outside off, Amini looks to cut but misses. This lands just in front of the keeper, hge lets it through and it goes to the fence.
Short and outside off, Amini slashes at it but misses.
FOUR! Heaved away! On middle, the slog sweep is out, it is hit over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Darted on the pads, Assad Vala flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
A single now as this is worked down to mid off.
Floated and full, on off. Amini smothers it to covers.
Looped up, around off, worked back to the bowler.
On off, defended out.
FOUR BYES! MIsses everyone. This is floated and angled down leg. Amini fails to flick it away and the keeper fails to read it as well. The ball runs down to fine leg and into the ropes.
Wesley Madhevere to bowl from the other end.
Short ball, on off. Amini pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, on the pads, tucked to square leg.
Papua New Guinea and Assad Vala are off the mark. It is short and on off. Assad Vala comes down the track and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Length and on off, defended out.
A length ball, angled down leg. Assad Vala tucks it to the leg side.

OUT! RUN OUT! Brilliant piece of fielding by Sean Williams. Papua New Guinea lose a wicket on the very first delivery. Richard Ngarava starts with a full-length ball, around off. Lega Siaka swats it to covers and scampers across for a single. Sean Williams picks the ball and cleanly and scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end. The umpire raises his finger in a flash, no need to consult the third umpire here. Charles Amini is the new man in.
